title: Short turns
subtitle: Seen from the front, and what your boots will show
steps: Pick a smooth, moderately steep slope.
Keep your upper body quiet and facing downhill.
Make quick, rounded turns and stay centred over your boots.

callouts.text: More turns in the same time: the humps come about every second.
Quick switch of edges: the line crosses the middle sharply.
Even spacing and height means a steady rhythm.

footnote: Illustration of a typical shape, not a target. Tilt is relative, not degrees.
